title: Good habits
info: Before you move, look at the whole board. Ask whether your king is safe.
Notice what the other player is threatening. Try not to leave a piece loose if you can help it.

questions.q: A useful question before you move is

options: only the square you touched last game
the whole board, not only your favorite piece
nothing protects it and the other player can take it
it is still on its start square on move one
hiding every piece in a corner
bringing them off the back rank into the game
moving only the king back and forth

questions.q: If you see a check against you next move, you should
options: deal with it before a side plan
start a new count of the squares
resign every time you are checked once

questions.q: Type the piece you must keep safe.
